Nitya Upahar for Ekushey
2017-02-21T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/lifestyle/check-it-out/nitya-upahar-ekushey-1363702

To mark the occasion of Ekushey February, also observed as the International Mother Language day, fashion brand Nitya Upahar has brought out a new collection consisting of five different designs for both adults and children.
